portfolio.title: Sathya Maruthamuthu
portfolio.subtitle: Senior Frontend Developer
portfolio.description: Senior Frontend Developer with 10+ years building scalable, high-performance e-commerce platforms in React.js — from checkout and payments to product catalog and order management. I've led frontend teams of up to 8 engineers delivering enterprise applications for brands including Keurig, Toms, Kraft, L.L.Bean, and Kohl's, with a focus on reusable component architecture, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals performance. I care as much about the codebase my team inherits as the product our users see.
portfolio.shortdescription: A developer with dedication and passion for creating innovative web applications and user experiences.

projects.name: Nuskin Enterprise Ecommerce Application
projects.description: Contributed as an individual frontend developer on Nuskin's enterprise e-commerce platform, building key modules across the shopping journey — subscription management, payment integration, cart, checkout, and order management. Worked within a reusable React component library to keep implementations consistent across the application, and built with responsiveness and ADA compliance in mind throughout. Collaborated closely with backend teams to wire up secure, reliable API integrations for each module. Enterprise project — source proprietary, screenshots above.

projects.name: Mysite Redesign
projects.description: Led a team of 8 frontend developers through a full redesign of an aging client site that had fallen behind on UX after years without an update. Architected the rebuild using Micro Frontend Architecture — developing and building the new experience as a standalone application, then integrating it into the existing Nuskin codebase. This let the team ship independently without blocking or destabilizing the main application, and gave the client a modern experience without a risky full rewrite. Directed sprint planning and code reviews throughout delivery. Enterprise project — source proprietary.
